body:
**Backups, a page of their own**
- **Backups** has its own entry in the menu, below UE4SS. Everything about save backups is there now, out of Settings: the save folder, the backup each time you start the game, and **Back up now**.
- **Normal and Personal:** normal backups are on the left. A slider sets how many the app keeps, from 2 to 20 (6 by default). The green arrow moves a backup to **Personal** on the right, where the app never removes it and it does not count. The red arrow moves it back.
- **Notes:** give every backup a note, such as "Before the final boss". Type one next to **Back up now** for a new backup.
- **Delete** a backup you do not need, after a question.

**Also new**
- A tighter menu, no subtexts under the page titles, and the version as the title of the About page.

**Thanks** to EstusFlask for the idea of a chosen number of backups and its first version (#21).

**Install:** unzip `uemm_2.1.0.zip` into a folder you can write to, for example `Documents\UE MM`, and start `UEModManager.exe`. One zip for every game. It needs the [.NET 8 Desktop Runtime (x64)](https://dotnet.microsoft.com/download/dotnet/8.0).

**Update from an older version:** the app offers the update at start; one click installs it. Your backups stay; the app now keeps 6 by default instead of 5. Or replace `UEModManager.exe` with the new one. The `Data` folder stays. `uemm_phantom-blade-zero_2.1.0.zip` is the same file under its old name, for older versions of the app.

**Something does not work?** In the app, open Settings ▸ Report a problem, copy the report and open an [issue](https://github.com/KintaroModding/uemodmanager/issues) with it.
